overview: This paper proposes DiffSDA, a modal-agnostic unsupervised framework that leverages diffusion models to sequentially disentangle static and dynamic factors from video, audio, and time-series data, using a dependent prior, a single score matching loss, and an EDM-based architecture.

modules.name: Multimodal Data Preprocessing
modules.description: Handles the diverse data preprocessing pipelines for video (cropping, resizing, and mapping to latent space via pre-trained VQ-VAE), audio (Mel-spectrogram extraction, segmentation), and time-series (normalization, feature extraction), preparing modal-agnostic sequence inputs.

modules.name: Multimodal Sequence DataLoader
modules.description: Implements custom PyTorch Dataset and DataLoader classes for all benchmarks (VoxCeleb, CelebV-HQ, TIMIT, PhysioNet, etc.), managing sequence sampling, frame selection, and batch generation for diverse modalities.

modules.name: Sequential Semantic Encoder
modules.description: Implements the encoder architecture that extracts interdependent static and dynamic factors, using a U-Net backbone for video and an MLP for other modalities, followed by linear layers and a dual-LSTM structure to output the static vector and dynamic sequence vectors.

modules.name: EDM Stochastic Encoder & Noise Scheduler
modules.description: Implements the forward diffusion process following the EDM framework, adding Gaussian noise to the input sequence based on the continuous noise schedule to generate the noisy latent variables for the reverse process.

modules.name: EDM Stochastic Decoder (Denoiser)
modules.description: Constructs the denoiser network that parameterizes the reverse diffusion process, taking noisy inputs, time steps, and disentangled factors (conditioned via Adaptive Group Normalization), and outputting denoised samples using EDM-specific skip connections and scaling factors.

modules.name: DiffSDA Unified Score Matching Loss
modules.description: Implements the single, unified score estimation loss function based on EDM formulation, calculating the weighted mean squared error between the denoiser output and the target signal, without relying on auxiliary KL-divergence or mutual information terms.

modules.name: DiffSDA Autoencoder Training Loop
modules.description: Orchestrates the end-to-end training workflow for the autoencoder components (Semantic Encoder, Stochastic Encoder, Decoder), managing gradient accumulation, mixed-precision training, and optimizer steps based on the unified loss.

modules.name: Dependent Latent DDIM Prior
modules.description: Implements the Latent Diffusion model using DDIM to learn the joint dependent distribution of static and dynamic factors, allowing for unconditional sampling of interdependent latent variables.

modules.name: EDM-based Stochastic Sampler
modules.description: Implements the conditioned reverse sampling algorithm (Algorithm 1) using the EDM framework, utilizing Heun's 2nd-order method and stochastic churn to iteratively denoise latent variables conditioned on static and dynamic factors.

modules.name: Stochastic Encoding Algorithm
modules.description: Implements the deterministic-to-stochastic encoding procedure (Algorithm 2), which maps a clean data sample to a noisy latent representation while preserving the semantic structure, crucial for reconstruction and swap tasks.

modules.name: Conditional & Unconditional Swap Logic
modules.description: Implements the inference logic for conditional swapping (mixing static factors from one sequence with dynamic factors from another) and unconditional swapping (sampling new factors from the DDIM prior while freezing the other).

modules.name: Zero-Shot Cross-Dataset Transfer
modules.description: Implements the evaluation pipeline for zero-shot generalization, applying the pre-trained encoder and decoder of one dataset (e.g., VoxCeleb) to extract and swap factors from an unseen dataset (e.g., MUG or CelebV-HQ) without fine-tuning.

modules.name: Multifactor PCA Traversal
modules.description: Implements the post-training linear disentanglement exploration, computing PCA on sampled static/dynamic latent spaces and traversing along principal components to visualize and isolate fine-grained semantic factors.

modules.name: Visual Disentanglement Metrics
modules.description: Calculates Average Euclidean Distance (AED) for identity/object preservation and Average Keypoint Distance (AKD) for motion preservation using pre-trained face recognition and pose estimation models, alongside reconstruction MSE.

modules.name: Audio & Time Series Metrics
modules.description: Implements evaluation metrics for non-visual modalities, including Equal Error Rate (EER) and Disentanglement Gap for audio speaker identification, and AUPRC, AUROC, MAE for time-series prediction and classification tasks.

modules.name: Generative Quality Assessment
modules.description: Implements Frechet Video Distance (FVD) for assessing the overall generation quality and distribution matching of the video sequences, and DNSMOS for evaluating the perceptual quality of generated audio.

modules.name: Configuration & Experiment Management
modules.description: Manages YAML/JSON configurations for different datasets and modalities, handles experiment tracking (logging, TensorBoard/WandB integration), and implements model checkpointing (saving/loading) for the multi-component diffusion architecture.
